selection.temporal_contract: Each segment is continuous within its own original sequence. Different sequences are independent recordings; never concatenate as one continuous 300-frame stream.

limitations: No IMU selected/provided in this subset
Outdoor vehicle-mounted scene, not low-mounted quadruped indoor/stairs ground truth
Semantic ground classes are not identical to geometric support labels
No independent ideal cleaned-map artifact; moving labels are per scan
Only the two selected segments are present; complete-sequence poses/times metadata are preserved
